Homework: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Keep shining, superstar. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-3 vs man united2112 | You: 7.7 (12th worst match performance)
push.body:
Your 12th worst match performance, BellyTb1: a 7.7. A dip, not a slide.

DID WELL
+ 32 passes (up from your usual 17). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ A goal against man united2112, your first since Oct 2. That's what the ball's for, and you knew it.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1. Do that again.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Quick one: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). Here's the deal: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- No key passes from 32 passes. Easy money: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from. You're closer than you think.
- You and buddskees were both flagged for defensive work rate. Fix it as a pair: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 1-3 to man united2112. One loss, many matches left.

Daily reps: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

Brick by brick. - Coach Lasso
